headword: {男女|だんじょ}{平等|びょうどう}

definitions.gloss: gender equality; equality between men and women
definitions.explanation: The principle that men and women should have equal rights, opportunities, and treatment. A key concept in social discussions, law, and policy in Japan.

examples.japanese: {男女|だんじょ}{平等|びょうどう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
{男女|だんじょ}{平等|びょうどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}する→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧。
examples.english: To work toward achieving gender equality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{男女|だんじょ}{平等|びょうどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, awareness of gender equality is gradually spreading.
